header: THE LOOK OF THE PREMIUM TRAINS: I share it between the train rows and the fare finder. THE PREMIUM TRAINS. I tell a Vande Bharat or a Shatabdi that stops at Durgapur from the rest by a coloured badge in place of the plain class word, a thick coloured edge and a tint on its row (each has its own colour: cyan for Vande Bharat, indigo for Shatabdi). I do this only for the two the railway names so; the label comes from the source's own train type.
